verdict.rationale: Ledgy claims '70+ HRIS integrations to keep large volumes of data accurate,' implying HRIS sync capability, but there is no specific mention of named systems like Gusto or Rippling, no detail on how new hires/terminations flow into equity records, and no documentation of sync mechanics or setup. missing for 10: named HRIS connectors (Gusto/Rippling), documentation of new-hire/termination event handling, sync frequency/setup details, independent corroboration.
